g.text: BOUNDARY: SHM writer can forge pre-copy
• 4 KB buf, 2 s timeout, 0 key access
• Zero network sockets or HTTP code
• Re-checks SHA-256 on private copy only
straight to md-seal on frame loss
• C++17 std::atomic<uint32_t> odd/even fences + atomic 64-bit words
• Verdict, NCC, PCE, frame counters, 10-bin jitter & p50/p99 interval stats
• Writer (md-capture) never waits on HTTP readers (md-telemetry retries)
• Rejects tamper, duplicate leaf, swap, broken STH chain
• source: none emits explicit tail-truncation WARNING
• Requests .tsr timestamp over sha256(STH); openssl ts -verify
• Immutable external anchor prevents history rewrite &
• pywt db4 Mihcak wavelet + weighted MLE + 2D FFT PCE
• Dresden & VISION datasets: NOT YET MEASURED
• Bare-metal -40..+85 C ROC: NOT YET MEASURED
